patthana23.15:1.1: na kusalaṃ na maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana23.15:2.1: na kusalaṃ na maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana23.15:3.1: na kusalaṃ na maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha. nakusalattika nauppannattike kusalattika uppannattikaṃ
